sources.title: F027 Vogue Pizza Pan Stacking Rack 15 Slot

f027.summary: A tall, narrow stainless steel rack with 15 slots for holding pizza pans, screens and trays upright on a small counter footprint. It suits pizzerias and takeaways that want prepared bases or finished pizzas stored together near the oven.

highlights.text: 15 slots for storing pizza equipment in one place

f027.notes: Sources disagree on slot spacing: 1.5 inch (JD Catering) vs 2.5 inch (CS Catering); human should check. Warranty (1 year parts and labour, back to base) appeared only in a search snippet, not on a page read, so it is not recorded.
